text: Meet Ramesh. An ordinary man with an exhausting life. All he wants, after a long day… is to come home, and sleep.
But next door, the drilling never stops. His bed shakes. His walls tremble. His nights turn sleepless.
So he records it. Every tremor. Every night.
He takes the government to court. But his evidence is tampered. The records are rewritten. And officially… there was never any construction.
Instead of justice, Ramesh is handed a defamation case.
That very night, he lies awake again. The bed shakes. But this time… it isn't the construction.
By morning, rescuers pull survivors from the rubble, one by one. But Ramesh… is still trapped. No one knows where he is.
What if the vibrations we ignore today… could save lives tomorrow?
Introducing TremorMesh. Sense, map, and prove every tremor. Because every tremor tells a story. TremorMesh — Every Tremor Matters.
